title: an effect needs a destination this run does not permit
remedy: run under a profile that permits it, or use a capability that does not require it

title: an effect needs more autonomy than this run holds
remedy: raise the run's autonomy, or remove the effect

title: an effect exceeds the run's risk ceiling
remedy: run under a profile whose risk ceiling covers it

title: an effect requires human approval and this run cannot obtain one
remedy: run at act_with_approval or above with an approval handler configured

title: a consequential effect is declared with no acceptance condition covering it
remedy: state how the program will know the action succeeded

title: data flows into an operation whose destination may not receive it
remedy: de-identify before this step, or route it to a destination the label permits

title: a declassification states no method
remedy: name the process that lowers the label (de-identification, aggregation)

title: this policy does not permit declassification here
remedy: a named declassifier in the policy must perform it

title: a derived value claims a lower sensitivity than its inputs
remedy: add an explicit declassification, or carry the inputs' label forward

title: a licence term forbids the destination this step reaches
remedy: a research-only source may not be published or sent to a public provider

title: a value's label exceeds the run's data ceiling
remedy: run under a profile whose ceiling covers it

title: provenance weakens along this path
remedy: recorded so the claim's certainty can reflect it

title: a non-deterministic step declares no seed
remedy: set repro.seed, or state why the step cannot be seeded

title: a dataset version is unpinned
remedy: set repro.dataset_version so the run can be repeated against the same data

title: a tool version is unpinned
remedy: set repro.tool_version

title: an isolated component declares no environment
remedy: set repro.container_digest or repro.environment

title: the program requires preregistration and declares no protocol
remedy: add a protocol node and freeze it before the analysis runs

title: an analysis runs before the protocol it claims to follow is frozen
remedy: make the analysis depend on the protocol node

title: the program's token estimate exceeds the run's ceiling
remedy: reduce the plan, or run with a larger budget

title: the program's cost estimate exceeds the run's ceiling
remedy: reduce the plan, or run with a larger budget

title: the critical path exceeds the run's time ceiling
remedy: shorten the chain, or run with a longer deadline

title: the program needs more calls than the run's ceiling allows
remedy: reduce the number of steps, or run with a larger budget

title: a fan-out states no bound
remedy: set fan_out.max_items; an unbounded map over a produced list is an unbounded budget

title: a bounded fan-out still exceeds the run's ceiling
remedy: lower the bound, or run with a larger budget

title: a hypothesis has no prediction
remedy: state what the hypothesis implies that could be observed

title: a prediction has no falsifier
remedy: state the observation that would refute it; a prediction nothing could contradict generates work and no knowledge

title: a hypothesis has no alternative
remedy: name the competing explanation the work is meant to rule out

title: an experiment tests a hypothesis that is not in this program
remedy: declare the hypothesis, or correct the id

title: an experiment discriminates between no hypotheses
remedy: say which hypotheses the result would tell apart

title: a claim answers a question that is not in this program
remedy: declare the question, or correct the id

title: the program asserts a mechanism or efficacy claim and states no hypothesis
remedy: state the hypothesis the claim rests on, so it can be argued against

title: a prediction is never tested
remedy: add an analysis or experiment that reads it, or remove it

title: dependency names a node that is not in this program
remedy: add the node, or correct the id

title: the dependency graph has a cycle
remedy: break the cycle; a step cannot depend on its own output

title: an executing node names no objective
remedy: say what the step achieves

title: a tool node names no component
remedy: name a component_id from the registry

title: a model node must declare exactly one model effect
remedy: declare one of model.local, model.trusted_remote, model.public_remote

title: a delegate node must declare the delegate effect
remedy: declare effects: ["delegate"]

title: a tool node declares no effects
remedy: declare what the tool does; a step with no declared effect cannot be gated before it runs

title: a declaration declares effects
remedy: a hypothesis or a prediction performs nothing; remove the effects or make it an executing node

title: a port reads a node that produces no value
remedy: read from an executing node; a declaration has no result

title: the program has no executable node
remedy: add at least one model, tool or delegate node

title: the program states no acceptance condition
remedy: add acceptance: there is otherwise no definition of done

title: a payload literal reads like a reference to another node
remedy: declare an input port instead; a payload is never resolved

title: the node's role and its specification disagree
remedy: a hypothesis node carries a hypothesis spec, a prediction node a prediction spec, an analysis node an analysis spec

title: the declared repeat semantics contradict a declared effect
remedy: a step that commits laboratory or clinical resources is non_repeatable

title: a fan-out iterates a node that is not in this program
remedy: name the node whose result is iterated

title: a node requires evidence and declares no output schema
remedy: an evidence requirement implies a structured return; declare output_schema

title: multiple tests with no multiplicity correction
remedy: declare multiplicity: bonferroni, holm, bh or permutation

title: the number of tests is not stated
remedy: state analysis.tests so multiplicity can be judged

title: a confirmatory analysis states neither sample size nor power
remedy: state analysis.sample_size and analysis.power

title: a survival analysis states no censoring strategy
remedy: state analysis.censoring

title: a proportional-hazards model does not check its assumption
remedy: set analysis.proportional_hazards_checked once the check is in the plan

title: feature selection uses the evaluation data
remedy: set analysis.feature_selection: train_only

title: a predictive model is evaluated with no held-out data
remedy: declare analysis.data_split: train_test, cross_validation or external

title: a subgroup analysis was not preregistered
remedy: preregister the subgroups, or report the analysis as exploratory

title: a discovery analysis declares no null model
remedy: declare analysis.null_model: permutation, random_features or negative_control; a significant result is not a finding until it beats one

title: a batch variable is declared and not adjusted for
remedy: set analysis.batch_adjusted, or state why the batch cannot confound

title: missing data handling is unstated
remedy: state analysis.missingness

title: no interval estimate is reported
remedy: set analysis.reports_interval; a point estimate without one is not a result

title: a discovery claim rests on a single unreplicated analysis
remedy: declare analysis.replication, or narrow the claim

title: the significance threshold is implausible
remedy: alpha is a probability; state the one the analysis will use

title: more tests are declared than the data could support
remedy: check analysis.tests against the rows the input produces

title: a claim node states no claim type
remedy: state produces.claim: what kind of assertion, about whom, how firmly

title: no input evidence licenses this claim
remedy: weaken the claim, change its kind, or add a source whose design reaches it

title: the claim reaches beyond its evidence
remedy: set claim.extrapolation_declared so the release records the stretch, or narrow the claim

title: evidence provenance is unstated or unevidential
remedy: state how the source was obtained; a value the system generated is not evidence for its own conclusion

title: a retrieval node produces no evidence type
remedy: state produces.evidence, including the study design

title: a claim node reads no evidence
remedy: bind the claim to the step that produced its evidence

title: a source is marked retracted
remedy: remove it; a retracted source cannot support a claim

title: an input's expected type does not match what the source produces
remedy: correct the expected_type, or the pointer
